purpose: One shared calibration corpus for the rule that a drafted pitch must actually ASK for something (#1889, #2531). Two implementations judge it, the TypeScript eval (src/lib/prepEval.asksAboutPhotographyPlans) and the Swift draft lint (DraftCheck), and twin implementations in two languages consume one shared committed fixture rather than each carrying its own idea of the rule (L26).
acceptsMatterMost: The accept side is the half that protects a good draft. Every accepting body here is a REAL compliant draft from fixtures/prep-eval, which words the ask nine different ways because the runbook tells the run to reword it every time. A rule pinned to one spelling would fail exactly the drafts it exists to protect (L104).
rejectsAreDerived: Every rejecting body is a real body with its ask sentence removed, or a real body plus one of the rewrites the runbook names. None is invented, so none can describe a draft the run cannot produce (L48).
